name: Vocational Rehabilitation

name: Speech and Language Connection Services LLC - Hialeah Gardens
description: Bilingual pediatric clinic serving neurodiverse children from 18 months. Speech, occupational and music therapy in 60-minute sessions, AAC support for minimally verbal children, plus an FES-UA home education instructional program.

extra_answer: Medically fragile primarily. Site names tracheostomies, gastrostomy tubes and premature babies as qualifying; developmental delay appears only in broad terms. Autism and developmental disability are never named specifically.
description: PPEC medical daycare for children birth to 21 needing continual nursing. On-site PT, OT and speech including swallowing work and non-verbal communication support, plus special-education instruction and free transport to the centre.

description: Pediatric therapy company serving ages 0-21 including children with autism, cerebral palsy and developmental delays. Speech, occupational and physical therapy, non-emergency medical transportation, and a PPEC programme added in 2023.

name: Ascend Transition Services

description: Solo DPT-led concierge practice offering in-home and outdoor pediatric and adult physical therapy, massage, sensory and gross-motor play classes, family sensory-regulation coaching, workshops and telehealth across Broward County.
